entries.description: Footsteps or skittering claws announce the approach of roaming inhabitants.
A distant groan of stone settling, a sudden chilling gust, or faint chanting in the dark.
Torches gutter and burn low; light sources must be renewed or shadows press closer.
Fresh tracks, dripping fluid, or a freshly disturbed cobweb indicates nearby activity.
Dust falls from the rafters or water rises slightly in low-lying channels.
An oppressive, unnatural silence settles over the corridors, heightening paranoia.
